plain: A large military unit made up of several battalions.

webster.text: A party or division of troops, or soldiers, whether cavalry or infantry, regular or militia, commanded by a brigadier.

example.quote: The division of the militia into brigades, regiments and companies, made in pursuance of the militia laws now in force, shall be considered as the proper division of the militia of this state, until the same shall be altered by some future law.
